title: Add Google Search Console verification meta tag to HTML head

requirements.summary: Add the provided Google Search Console site verification meta tag to the app HTML <head>.
acceptanceCriteria: The file frontend/index.html contains the exact meta tag <meta name="google-site-verification" content="J4tH72RdBxc6a0hSEbceJV6xZn8daPsAgqs7i2HbVWI" /> within the <head> section.
The application builds successfully after the change.
When viewing the page source in the browser, the meta tag is present in the rendered HTML head.

file_operations.description: Insert the exact Google Search Console verification meta tag <meta name="google-site-verification" content="J4tH72RdBxc6a0hSEbceJV6xZn8daPsAgqs7i2HbVWI" /> inside the <head> section (alongside existing meta tags). Ensure frontend.immutablePaths constraints are respected before editing.
